fact: The article says about 54% of adults in Gabon are unbanked, per the World Bank's Global Findex 2025, which leaves about 46% with an account.
GSMA's October 2026 report on Gabon says 62% of adults hold a mobile money account; the document does not name the underlying survey.
UNCDF's 2025 digital and financial literacy survey of 1,601 Gabonese across nine provinces found 54% hold a formal financial account, 60% in urban areas against 19% in rural areas.
